news.title: Chelsea stars named in Premier League Fan Team of the Week
news.title_zh: 切尔西球星入选英超本周最佳球迷团队
news.body_en: Chelsea's impressive 2-0 victory over Manchester United has earned the Blues further recognition, with three of our players selected in the Premier League's Official Fan Team of the Week for Matchweek 9. Estevao Willian, Romeo Lavia and Morgan Rogers have all been included in the fan-selected XI for Matchweek 9 after playing important roles in Saturday's victory over the Red Devils. The Blues returned to winning ways with an excellent display at Stamford Bridge, as second-half goals from Rogers and Cole Palmer secured all three points for Xabi Alonso's side. Rogers broke the deadlock early in the second half with a superb individual effort, collecting Lavia's pass in midfield before driving forward and finding the net. The England international's impressive attacking display earned him a place in the Team of the Week, alongside Lavia, who was instrumental in Chelsea's victory. Our No.45 produced an outstanding all-round performance in the heart of midfield, demonstrating his composure in possession, ability to break up opposition attacks and quality on the ball. The Belgian's influential display also saw him voted Player of the Match by supporters on the Chelsea Official App, before claiming the Premier League's Player of the Matchweek award. Estevao completes the Chelsea trio selected by supporters, with the Brazilian winger recognised for his lively attacking performance against United. The 19-year-old was a constant threat with his skill, movement and creativity, helping the Blues secure an important victory in front of the Stamford Bridge faithful. Chelsea's three representatives are joined by players from Arsenal, Aston Villa, Bournemouth, Brighton & Hove Albion and Tottenham Hotspur in the final XI, which was selected by supporters voting on the Premier League's official website. Premier League Official Fan Team of the Week – Matchweek 9 Goalkeeper: Bart Verbruggen (Brighton & Hove Albion). Defenders: Ezri Konsa (Arsenal), Jan Paul van Hecke (Tottenham Hotspur), Luka Vuskovic (Brighton & Hove Albion), Gabriel (Arsenal). Midfielders: Estevao Willian (Chelsea), Declan Rice (Arsenal), Roméo Lavia (Chelsea), Morgan Rogers (Chelsea). Forwards: Nicolas Jackson (Aston Villa), Evanilson (Bournemouth).

news.title: Chelsea Women vs Everton: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足 vs 埃弗顿：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: We return to Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon when we take on Everton in the Women's Super League. The Blues are currently top of the WSL table on goal difference - sitting on equal points with Manchester City - with our tally helped by our 6-0 victory against Charlton at The Valley last time out. We now prepare to play our fifth game at the Bridge this season when the Toffees visit. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Everton, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Everton takes place on Sunday 8 November 2026 at Stamford Bridge, with kick-off scheduled for 12.45pm UK time. The best way to see the game is to join us at the Bridge! Tickets are still available to purchase here. If you can't make the game in person,  then you can watch the action live on Sky Sports Premier League and Sky Mix. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Everton Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow along via Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. After drawing with Aston Villa in our first league game of the campaign, the Blues have since won seven WSL games in a row. This is our best winning streak in the same top-flight season since winning our first nine matches under head coach Sonia Bompastor in 2024/25. We have scored 18 goals across our last four WSL games, netting three times twice and six times twice. The Toffees are eighth in the table after eight games. They have kept three clean sheets this season, only one fewer than they managed across the whole of the 2025/26 campaign (four in 22). Chelsea (five) are the only other side with more than two shutouts in the competition this term. Chelsea have won 16 of our last 18 WSL games against Everton (one draw and one defeat), netting three or more goals in 11 of our last 12 victories. Everton were 1-0 winners in this fixture at Kingsmeadow last season, ending a run of eight consecutive away defeats against Chelsea in the Women’s Super League. The Toffees have never won back-to-back WSL away matches versus the Blues.
news.body_zh: 周六下午我们将返回斯坦福桥，在女子超级联赛中迎战埃弗顿。蓝军目前在 WSL 积分榜上以净胜球优势位居榜首，与曼城积分相同，上一场比赛我们在山谷球场以 6-0 战胜查尔顿，帮助我们取得了进球。我们现在准备在太妃糖队来访时打本赛季在大桥的第五场比赛。以下是您需要了解的有关如何观看切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿的所有信息，包括开球时间以及如何关注切尔西官方频道的比赛。切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿的比赛将于 2026 年 11 月 8 日星期日在斯坦福桥举行，开球时间定于英国时间中午 12 点 45 分。观看比赛的最佳方式就是来到桥上加入我们！门票仍然可以在这里购买。如果您无法亲自观看比赛，则可以在天空体育超级联赛和 Sky Mix 上观看比赛直播。与往常一样，球队新闻、实时更新和比赛报道将在切尔西官方应用程序和切尔西网站上的切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿比赛中心提供。您还可以通过 X、Facebook、Instagram 和 TikTok 上的 Chelsea Women 社交媒体渠道进行关注。在本赛季首场联赛战平阿斯顿维拉后，蓝军已经连续七场赢得 WSL 比赛。这是自 2024/25 年在主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 带领下赢得前九场比赛以来，我们在同一顶级联赛赛季中取得的最佳连胜纪录。在过去的四场 WSL 比赛中，我们打进了 18 个进球，分别进了 3 球、2 球和 6 球。八场比赛过后，太妃糖队在积分榜上排名第八。他们本赛季保持了三场不失球，仅比他们在2025/26赛季整个赛季的表现（22场比赛中的四场）少一场。切尔西（五场）是本赛季唯一一支在比赛中被淘汰两次以上的球队。切尔西在过去 18 场对阵埃弗顿的 WSL 比赛中赢了 16 场（1 平 1 负），在过去 12 场胜利中有 11 场打入 3 个或更多进球。上赛季埃弗顿在金斯梅多的这场比赛中以1-0获胜，结束了女超联赛客场对切尔西的八连败。太妃糖队从未在 WSL 客场对阵蓝军的比赛中连续获胜。

news.title: UEFA Youth League report: Cobham Next Gen 2-3 Flora Tallinn (4-5 aggregate)
news.title_zh: 欧足联青年联赛报告：科巴姆下一代 2-3 弗洛拉塔林（总比分 4-5）
news.body_en: Chelsea Cobham Next Gen exited the UEFA Youth League after a 3-2 defeat to Flora Tallinn. We went ahead within two minutes of both halves but a late penalty sent us out of the competition. Mathis Eboue gave us an early lead with a low, driven finish into the far corner, but Sander Alamaa equalised shortly afterwards, making it 1-1 at half-time. In the second half, we began in similar fashion with Ibrahim Rabbaj putting us back in front with his second touch after coming off the bench. Unfortunately, Flora responded quickly again, this time through Marten Kukkonen. They later took the lead from the penalty spot through Alamaa, ending our European aspirations this term. Flora enjoyed a fast start in the reverse fixture, but today it was Chelsea who set the tone immediately, going ahead within two minutes. Yisa Alao lofted the ball up to Ezenwata who nodded it into the path of Eboue. The Blues winger initially stood up his marker before dropping a shoulder, going down the line and rifling his shot against the post and into the bottom corner. Our lead didn’t last long as Alamaa, who scored a brace in the first leg, pickpocketed Alfie Osborne and went through on goal to equalise. We enjoyed the better chances of the first half and neared our second of the afternoon when Ezenwata played a driven pass across the face of goal. Eboue met it first but miskicked his shot, and the ball subsequently fell to Alao, whose effort was snuffed out by Andero Tatrik. At the interval, the score remained level both on the afternoon and on aggregate. Rabbaj was introduced in the second half, replacing Osborne, and made an instant impact. Eboue proved a threat again down the left wing and cut back towards the penalty spot, where Rabbaj was waiting to tuck home with only his second touch. Unfortunately, Flora got back on level terms eight minutes later through Kukkonen. In the 69th minute, Grimwade picked up the ball on the edge of the box surrounded; he wriggled in and out, dodging at least three Flora defenders, before aiming for the top corner - but his effort sailed just over. Flora Tallinn won a penalty with 12 minutes remaining, which was converted by Alamaa to put the visitors in front. Eboue tried to provide the response, when he cut inside and went for the spectacular, but his strike was off target. Andrew Pennie was played through with limited minutes left on the clock, his shot was hard and low but denied by Flora. There were five minutes of additional time and we pushed for an equaliser, but we couldn’t find the all-important goal. This defeat spells the end of our involvement in this season's UEFA Youth League. Cobham Next Gen visit London rivals Tottenham Hotspur this Sunday at the Lamex Stadium. The game gets underway at 1pm GMT and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. Chelsea (4-3-3): Freddy Bernal; Yisa Alao, Olutayo Subuloye (c), Alfie Osborne (Ibrahim Rabbaj 46), Calvin Diakite (Jacob Hall 87); Heze Grimwade (Jashayde Greenwood 80), Reggie Watson, Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli; Sol Gordon (Riley Ebho 81), Chizaram Ezenwata, Mathis Eboue (Andrew Pennie 81)Unused subs: Toby Bell, Gabriel Sambou, Isago Silva, Josh HenryScorers: Eboue 2, Rabbaj 47Booked: Ezenwata 36, Alao 38, Watson 59Manager: Harry Hudson Flora Tallinn (4-1-4-1): Andero Tatrik; Patrick Pihlak (Risto Raudsalu 88), Ronald Sammul, Joosep Palts (c) Nikita Kalmokov (Karel Isok 46); Jaron Silm (Eerik Paltser 68); Denis Zotov (Ron Neltsas 69), Marten Kukkonen, Remo Valdmets, Sander Alamaa; Karl-Tristen Lorenz (Uku Korjus 77)Unused subs: Ron Sebastian Miss, Mark Kukk , Jaan Erik Poldma, Rocco OjaScorers: Alamaa 17, 78, Kukkonen 54Booked: Zotov 4, Lorenz 60, Neltsas 72, Raudsalu 90+3 Manager: Alstaar Andris
news.body_zh: 切尔西科巴姆下一代在以 3-2 输给弗洛拉塔林后退出欧洲青年联赛。上半场两分钟后我们就取得了领先，但最后时刻的点球让我们退出了比赛。马西斯·埃布埃 (Mathis Eboue) 的一记低射远角为我们取得领先，但桑德·阿拉马 (Sander Alamaa) 不久后扳平比分，半场结束时比分变为 1-1。下半场，我们以类似的方式开始，易卜拉欣·拉巴伊替补出场后的第二次触球让我们重新领先。不幸的是，弗洛拉再次迅速做出了反应，这次是通过马丁·库科宁。随后他们通过阿拉马点球取得领先，结束了我们本赛季的欧洲之旅。弗洛拉在相反的比赛中取得了快速的开局，但今天是切尔西立即定下了基调，在两分钟内取得了领先。伊萨·阿拉奥 (Yisa Alao) 将球传给埃森瓦塔 (Ezenwata)，埃森瓦塔 (Ezenwata) 将球点到了埃布埃 (Eboue) 的路线上。这位蓝军边锋一开始站了起来，然后肩膀一沉，沿着底线将球射向门柱，飞入球门底角。我们的领先优势并没有持续太久，首回合梅开二度的阿拉马在扒窃阿尔菲·奥斯本后射门扳平比分。我们享受了上半场更好的机会，并在接近下午的第二场比赛时，Ezenwata 将球传过球门。埃布埃先接球，但射门失误，球随后传给了阿拉奥，后者的射门被安德罗·塔特里克扑出。中场休息期间，下午的比分和总比分都保持持平。下半场拉巴伊替换奥斯本上场，并立即发挥作用。埃布埃在左翼再次证明了威胁，并切向点球点，拉巴伊正在等待第二次触球得分。不幸的是，八分钟后弗洛拉通过库科宁扳平了比分。第69分钟，格里姆韦德禁区边缘得球；他蠕动着进进出出，躲开了至少三名弗洛拉防守队员，然后瞄准了球顶角——但他的射门稍稍高出。弗洛拉·塔林在比赛还剩 12 分钟时赢得点球，阿拉马主罚命中，客队取得领先。埃布埃试图做出回应，他内切并打出精彩的射门，但他的射门偏离了目标。安德鲁·彭尼在比赛还剩有限的时间时，他的射门又硬又低，但被弗洛拉挡出。补时还有五分钟，我们力争扳平比分，但我们没能找到最重要的进球。这场失利意味着我们本赛季青年欧洲联赛的结束。科巴姆下一代将在本周日在美时球场客场挑战伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。比赛于格林威治标准时间下午 1 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。切尔西（4-3-3）：弗雷迪·伯纳尔； Yisa Alao、Olutayo Subuloye (c)、Alfie Osborne (Ibrahim Rabbaj 46)、Calvin Diakite (Jacob Hall 87)；赫泽·格里姆韦德（Jashayde Greenwood 80）、雷吉·沃森、迈赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利；索尔·戈登（莱利·埃博 81）、奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔、马蒂斯·埃布埃（安德鲁·彭尼 81）未上场替补：托比·贝尔、加布里埃尔·桑布、伊萨戈·席尔瓦、约什·亨利得分：埃布埃 2、拉巴杰 47 黄牌：埃森瓦塔 36、阿劳 38、沃森 59 经理：哈里·哈德森 弗洛拉·塔林(4-1-4-1)：安德罗·塔特里克； Patrick Pihlak (Risto Raudsalu 88)、Ronald Sammul、Joosep Palts (c) Nikita Kalmokov (Karel Isok 46)；杰伦·席尔姆（Eerik Paltser 68）； Denis Zotov（Ron Neltsas 69）、Marten Kukkonen、Remo Valdmets、Sander Alamaa；卡尔-特里斯坦·洛伦茨 (Uku Korjus 77) 未上场替补：罗恩·塞巴斯蒂安·米斯、马克·库克、贾恩·埃里克·波尔德马、罗科·奥哈得分：阿拉马 17、78、库科宁 54 黄牌：佐托夫 4、洛伦茨 60、内尔察斯 72、劳德萨鲁 90+3 经理：阿尔斯塔尔·安德里斯

news.title: Veerle Buurman on the Ballon d'Or and playing in front of Hannah Hampton
news.title_zh: 维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 荣获金球奖并在汉娜·汉普顿 (Hannah Hampton) 面前表演
news.body_en: It’s been another strong start to the season for Veerle Buurman. Still only 20, the defender has started nine of our 13 matches this season and looks as assured as players with many more years of experience. At the end of her first campaign with Chelsea, the Dutch international won the Women’s Super League Rising Star Award for her outstanding performances in the backline during 2025/26. Now that she is used to playing in the WSL, she reflected on the strength of the league and picked out her standout moments from her time with the Blues so far. ‘The quality in the whole league, all the teams, is going up,’ she explained. ‘Every weekend there's a big game, and it’s important to take the three points. There’s never an easy game. ‘This is my second season at Chelsea, and winning the Rising Star Award from the WSL was of course really nice. 'I’d also pick out my first goal for Chelsea as another big moment, but being a part of this team means a lot already, and I’m enjoying my football here, being on the pitch with a lot of girls I can learn from.’ Buurman also attended this year’s Ballon d’Or ceremony, having been named on the five-player shortlist for the Women’s Young Talent of the Year award. Barcelona’s Vicky Lopez scooped the trophy on this occasion, but the youngster reflected on how it felt to be named as one of the five best young talents in world football. ‘It meant a lot to be nominated,’ she said. ‘I never expected it, but I was really proud and happy. A lot of the girls came to me to say congratulations when I found out – it was a really nice moment on the pitch before training.’ It must be reassuring for a young defender to be playing in front of a goalkeeper of Hannah Hampton’s calibre. Buurman took the time to praise her Chelsea colleague and explained why she feels so at ease with her as the last line of defence. ‘Hannah is really good,’ she continued. ‘She's showing it on the field in every game in terms of when she's on the line, but also on the ball. Her passing is amazing, and she's showing every season how good she is on the field. ‘If you're playing and you know Hannah is behind you in goal, that's really nice. You feel confident. You know she has your back. She’s making saves, she also has a lot of confidence on the ball, and she's showing that every game.’ It’s not just at Chelsea that Buurman is thriving. She’s already earned 20 caps for the Netherlands and will be at the Women’s World Cup in 2027 should they come through their qualifying double header against Slovenia in early December. ‘Every time you put on the national team shirt, it's something to be really proud of and never gets normal,’ she concluded. ‘We have important games coming up in the next international window. We need to qualify for the World Cup. If we qualify, it will be amazing to be there as a team.’
news.body_zh: 对于 Veerle Buurman 来说，这是本赛季的又一个强劲开局。这位年仅 20 岁的后卫已经在我们本赛季的 13 场比赛中首发了 9 场，看起来和拥有多年经验的球员一样自信。在切尔西的第一个赛季结束时，这位荷兰国脚凭借2025/26赛季在后防线上的出色表现赢得了女超联赛新星奖。现在她已经习惯了 WSL 的比赛，她回顾了联赛的实力，并挑选了迄今为止她在蓝军时期的精彩时刻。 “整个联盟、所有球队的质量都在提高，”她解释道。 “每个周末都有一场重要的比赛，拿下三分很重要。从来没有一场简单的比赛。 “这是我在切尔西的第二个赛季，赢得 WSL 新星奖当然非常棒。 “我还认为我在切尔西的第一个进球是另一个重要时刻，但成为这支球队的一员已经意味着很多，我很享受在这里的足球，在球场上和很多我可以学习的女孩在一起。”布尔曼还参加了今年的金球奖颁奖典礼，被提名为年度女子青年才俊奖的五人候选名单。巴塞罗那队的维琪·洛佩兹这次捧起了奖杯，但这位年轻人反思了被评为世界足坛五名最佳年轻天才之一的感受。 “获得提名意义重大，”她说。 “我没想到会这样，但我真的很自豪和高兴。当我发现这一消息时，很多女孩都来向我表示祝贺——训练前在球场上的那一刻真的很美好。”对于一名年轻的后卫来说，在汉娜·汉普顿这样的门将面前踢球一定会让人感到安心。布尔曼花时间赞扬了她的切尔西同事，并解释了为什么她对她作为最后一道防线感到如此自在。 “汉娜真的很棒，”她继续说道。 “她在每场比赛中都在场上展示了这一点，无论是在罚球线上，还是在控球时。她的传球令人惊叹，每个赛季她都在场上展示着自己的出色表现。 “如果你在比赛时知道汉娜在你身后，那就太好了。你感到自信。你知道她会支持你。她能够做出扑救，她对球也充满信心，她在每场比赛中都表现出了这一点。” 布尔曼不仅仅在切尔西茁壮成长。她已经为荷兰队出场 20 次，如果荷兰队在 12 月初对阵斯洛文尼亚的预选赛双头赛中获胜，她将参加 2027 年女足世界杯。 “每次穿上国家队球衣，你都会感到非常自豪，而且永远不会变得正常，”她总结道。 “我们将在下一个国际比赛窗口进行重要的比赛。我们需要获得世界杯参赛资格。如果我们晋级，作为一个团队来到那里将是令人惊奇的。”

news.title: Marco Palestra: My Football Firsts
news.title_zh: 马可·帕莱斯特拉：我的足球第一次
news.body_en: After making his full Chelsea debut at the weekend, Marco Palestra shares his earliest memories and experiences in football. The Italian full-back had to wait to make his first start for the Blues, in Saturday's 2-0 win over Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, following his summer move from Atalanta, and now he answers our quickfire questions so you can get to know him a little better... What was the first football match you went to? The first match that I remember that I went to see was Atalanta against Palermo in Bergamo. Atalanta lost 1-0, I remember, and I had just joined Atalanta. I was 10 years old, I think. What was the first football kit you owned? I think one of my first jerseys that I had was one of Ronaldinho, a Brazil shirt. I remember that one. What was the first team you played for? The first team I played for was Assago, which is near where I was born. I played there for four years, it was a good time. Who was the first coach who gave you important advice? I can’t remember any specific advice but maybe when I was a bit older, like 16, our coach that changed my position. His name is Marco Fioretto. So he was the first one who moved me from midfield to out wide and he maybe changed my career. Who was your first team-mate who became a friend? I have one of my best friends, his name is Filippo Bonvento. I met him when I started playing at Assago when I was about four years old, and now he is still my best friend. So for sure him. Who was your first professional game against? My debut in professional football isn’t good, because I got a red card. I played for Atalanta Under-23s in the third league, Serie C, and I remember it was a difficult game and I got a red card, so it’s maybe not the best debut. I probably deserved it, it was two yellows because I made two fouls, but I didn’t have any experience at the time. Who was your first goal against? I will always remember my first goal. Again, it was for Atalanta Under-23s in the third league. It was against Albinoleffe, who are local rivals in Bergamo. The game finished 1-1, and I scored the first goal with a header. Can you remember the first time somebody recognised you in public? I don’t know. I think it would have been in Bergamo when I started to play in the third league with the Under-23s, probably around the city one guy recognised me. What was your first emotion when you signed for Chelsea? I was just happy because when I was young I never thought I could be a Chelsea player. So the first emotion was only happiness. Now I am still happy, but I need to improve myself to win with this team.
news.body_zh: 在周末完成切尔西首秀后，马科·帕莱斯特拉分享了他最早的足球记忆和经历。这位意大利边后卫在夏季从亚特兰大转会到斯坦福桥后，必须等到周六在斯坦福桥2-0战胜曼联的比赛中才能为蓝军首次首发，现在他回答了我们的快速问题，以便您可以更好地了解他......您去看的第一场足球比赛是哪场？我记得我去看的第一场比赛是亚特兰大在贝加莫对阵巴勒莫的比赛。我记得亚特兰大0-1输了，当时我刚刚加盟亚特兰大。我想，当时我10岁。您拥有的第一套足球装备是什么？我想我拥有的第一件球衣是罗纳尔迪尼奥的巴西球衣。我记得那个。你效力的第一支球队是哪支球队？我效力的第一支球队是阿萨戈队，它离我出生的地方很近。我在那里打了四年球，那是一段美好的时光。谁是第一个给你重要建议的教练？我不记得有什么具体的建议，但也许当我年纪大一点，比如 16 岁的时候，我们的教练改变了我的立场。他的名字叫马可·菲奥雷托。所以他是第一个把我从中场调到边路的人，他也许改变了我的职业生涯。谁是你第一个成为朋友的队友？我有一个最好的朋友，他的名字叫 Filippo Bonvento。我四岁左右开始在阿萨戈踢球时认识了他，现在他仍然是我最好的朋友。所以肯定是他。你的第一场职业比赛是对阵谁？我的职业足球首秀并不顺利，因为我得到了一张红牌。我在意丙第三级联赛亚特兰大U-23队效力，我记得那是一场艰难的比赛，我得到了一张红牌，所以这可能不是最好的处子秀。我可能活该，因为我犯了两次犯规，所以吃到了两张黄牌，但当时我没有任何经验。你的第一个进球是对阵谁？我将永远记住我的第一个目标。再次，这是第三联赛亚特兰大 23 岁以下青年队的比赛。对手是贝加莫的当地对手阿尔比诺莱夫队。比赛以1-1结束，我头球攻入第一个进球。你还记得第一次有人在公共场合认出你是什么时候吗？我不知道。我想当我开始为 23 岁以下青年队参加第三级联赛时，应该是在贝加莫，可能在城市周围有人认出了我。当你加盟切尔西时，你的第一感觉是什么？我很高兴，因为当我年轻的时候，我从来没有想过我可以成为一名切尔西球员。所以最初的情绪只有幸福。现在我仍然很高兴，但我需要提高自己才能与这支球队一起获胜。

news.title: Romeo Lavia wins Premier League Player of the Matchweek award
news.title_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚荣获英超比赛周最佳球员奖
news.body_en: Romeo Lavia has been named the Premier League's Player of the Matchweek following his outstanding performance in Chelsea's 2-0 victory over Manchester United at Stamford Bridge The Belgian midfielder produced an excellent all-round display as the Blues returned to winning ways on Saturday, playing an influential role in the heart of midfield and helping Xabi Alonso's side secure all three points. Lavia's composure in possession, ability to break up opposition attacks and intelligent distribution were key to Chelsea's impressive performance, while he also played an important part in our opening goal. It was the 22-year-old who won possession in midfield before supplying the pass for Morgan Rogers to break the deadlock early in the second half, with Cole Palmer later doubling our advantage from the penalty spot. Having already been voted Player of the Match by supporters on the Chelsea Official App, Lavia has now added another individual accolade following a vote by football fans on the Premier League's official website. Our No.45 came out on top in a six-player shortlist that also featured Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall, Oli McBurnie, Declan Rice, Jan Paul van Hecke and Bart Verbruggen. Speaking after Saturday's victory, Lavia reflected on the hard work behind his performances. He said: 'I feel very comfortable. Like I've always said, it's been in the weeks a lot of work that goes unseen with everyone in the building, at the training ground. So I'm very happy that it's all paying off and hopefully it just continues this way.' Head coach Alonso was also full of praise for the Belgian following his influential display against United. 'It was a top performance. In the last three weeks, I've seen a Romeo in top form. He is feeling good and feeling confident,' said Alonso. 'His game, from a midfielder's point of view, was very complete. He has done so many good things and I'm happy for him. He deserves huge recognition.' And that recognition has now arrived, with Lavia's latest accolade providing another reason to celebrate an impressive individual performance and an important Chelsea victory.
news.body_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚在切尔西在斯坦福桥2-0战胜曼联的比赛中表现出色，被评为英超比赛周最佳球员。这位比利时中场在周六蓝军重回胜利之路的过程中展现了出色的全面表现，在中场核心发挥了重要作用，帮助哈维·阿隆索的球队全取三分。拉维亚在控球时的冷静、瓦解对手进攻的能力以及聪明的分配能力是切尔西令人印象深刻的表现的关键，同时他也在我们的首个进球中发挥了重要作用。正是这位 22 岁的球员在中场赢得了控球权，然后在下半场早些时候为摩根·罗杰斯提供传球，打破了僵局，随后科尔·帕尔默在点球点将我们的优势扩大了一倍。拉维亚已经在切尔西官方应用程序上被球迷评选为全场最佳球员，继英超官方网站上球迷投票后，拉维亚又获得了另一项个人荣誉。我们的 45 号球员在六人入围名单中名列前茅，其他入围名单还包括基尔南·杜斯伯里·霍尔、奥利·麦克伯尼、德克兰·赖斯、扬·保罗·范赫克和巴特·维尔布鲁根。周六的胜利后，拉维亚回顾了他的表现背后的辛勤工作。他说：“我感觉很舒服。就像我一直说的那样，这几周以来，大楼里、训练场上的每个人都做了很多看不见的工作。所以我很高兴这一切都得到了回报，并希望它能继续这样下去。”在对阵曼联的比赛中，比利时人的表现很有影响力，主教练阿隆索也对他赞不绝口。 “这是一场顶级表演。在过去的三周里，我看到了罗密欧的最佳状态。他感觉很好并且充满信心，”阿隆索说。 “从中场球员的角度来看，他的比赛非常完整。他做了很多好事，我为他感到高兴。他值得得到巨大的认可。现在这种认可已经到来，拉维亚的最新荣誉为庆祝令人印象深刻的个人表现和切尔西的重要胜利提供了另一个理由。

news.title: WNL Cup Report: Oxford United Women 1-1 Chelsea Women Under-18s (3-4 on pens)
news.title_zh: WNL 杯赛报告：牛津联女足 1-1 切尔西 18 岁以下女足（笔杆 3-4）
news.body_en: Chelsea Women’s Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women’s League, reached the second round of the Women’s National League Cup after beating Oxford United Women 4-3 on penalties following a 1-1 draw at the MGroup Stadium. Carla Gardiner (in the picture above) gave the Blues a first-half lead before Oxford levelled shortly before the break. With the score level after 90 minutes, the tie went straight to a shootout, where Victoria Rudz saved Oxford’s fourth penalty and Gabi Storey scored the winning kick. Chelsea competed very well against an Oxford side who are top of the third tier and had not lost in any competition this season. Leanne Champ’s side edged the possession statistics and worked tirelessly throughout. The Blues showed great character and intent to go further in this competition than in previous years. Chelsea went ahead on 27 minutes. Patient combination play around our own box involving Storey, Lola Brown and Keira Johnson ended with the ball returned to Rudz, who went longer into the wide left channel under pressure from an Oxford forward. A mix-up between Oxford’s central midfielder and full-back sent the ball into the air, and Brown capitalised to restart the attack. She drove forward into space with options on either side and picked out Gardiner, who had peeled off to the left. Gardiner took a touch inside the box and unbalanced the Oxford centre-back with quick feet. The defender raised a leg to block, and the shot deflected into the net. Oxford equalised two minutes before half-time. Storey and Chloe Sarwie played short from a Chelsea goal kick to find captain Belle Sullivan centrally, but good Oxford pressure forced the Blues into a mistake, with the Yellows' number 10 slipping her finish across Rudz and into the net. Champ made a double change on the hour, as Aysia Matabaro and Stevie Sinclair replaced Rebekah Pierce and Gardiner. The score remained 1-1 at full-time, and under competition rules the tie went straight to penalties, with Oxford going first. Oxford converted their first three kicks, sending Rudz the wrong way each time. Brown buried Chelsea’s first low into the corner, and Chelsea N’Drin scored straight down the middle, but Sinclair’s effort went just wide of the left post. Rudz read Oxford’s fourth penalty well, saving a slow effort down to her right, and Nelly Las drove low and hard into the corner to level the shootout at 3-3. Oxford’s fifth taker then blasted high over the bar, and Storey stepped up to squeeze a low, hard penalty in past the goalkeeper to send the Blues through. Chelsea are in the draw for the second round of the Women’s National League Cup. The draw takes place at 7pm on Wednesday 4 November and will be shown on the FA WNL YouTube channel. The Blues return to PGA Division 1 action on Wednesday 4 November, when Sunderland travel to Cobham. Chelsea (3-4-3): Victoria Rudz; Chloe Sarwie, Gabi Storey, Zoe Ciccardini; Belle Sullivan (c), Keira Johnson, Chelsea N’Drin, Lola Brown; Rebekah Pierce (Aysia Matabaro 60), Carla Gardiner (Stevie Sinclair 60), Nelly LasUnused subs: Freya Weeks, Annie Boichat, Sophie Leach, Tess Finn, Jahmya PutmanScorers: Gardiner 27Penalties: Brown (scored), N’Drin (scored), Sinclair (missed), Las (scored), Storey (scored)Manager: Leanne Champ
news.body_zh: 参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队在 MGroup 体育场 1-1 战平后，点球大战以 4-3 击败牛津联女子队，进入女子国家联赛杯第二轮。卡拉·加德纳（上图）帮助蓝军在上半场取得领先，随后牛津队在中场休息前不久扳平比分。 90分钟后比分扳平，双方直接进入点球大战，维多利亚·鲁兹扑出牛津队的第四个点球，加比·斯托雷打进致胜一球。切尔西与牛津队的比赛表现出色，牛津队是第三梯队的顶级球队，本赛季在任何比赛中都没有输过。 Leanne Champ 的球队在控球数据上取得了优势，并且自始至终不知疲倦地工作。蓝军表现出了出色的性格，并决心在这场比赛中比往年走得更远。第27分钟，切尔西取得领先。斯托里、洛拉·布朗和凯拉·约翰逊在我们自己的禁区周围进行了耐心的组合比赛，最终球回到了鲁兹，鲁兹在牛津前锋的压力下进入了左路。牛津大学的中场球员和边后卫之间的失误将球传到了空中，布朗利用这一机会重新开始了进攻。她向前驶入太空，两边都有选择，并选中了从左侧脱离的加德纳。加德纳在禁区内触球，快速的脚步使牛津中后卫失去了平衡。防守队员抬腿挡出，射门偏入球网。半场结束前两分钟，牛津队扳平比分。斯托里和克洛伊·萨维在切尔西球门球后短距离找到队长贝尔·沙利文，但牛津队强大的压力迫使蓝军犯了一个错误，黄队的 10 号球穿过鲁兹并入网。钱普在整点做出了两次换人，艾西亚·马塔巴罗和史蒂夫·辛克莱取代了丽贝卡·皮尔斯和加德纳。全场比赛比分仍是1-1，根据比赛规则，双方直接进入点球大战，牛津队先胜。牛津队在前三场比赛中都取得了进球，但鲁兹每次都踢错了方向。布朗将切尔西的第一次低射埋入角球，切尔西的恩德林直接从中路得分，但辛克莱的射门稍稍偏出左门柱。鲁兹（Rudz）很好地解读了牛津队的第四个点球，将一记缓慢的射门扑出右侧，内莉·拉斯（Nelly Las）低位大力射入角球，将点球大战扳成3-3平。牛津队的第五名接球手随后射门高出横梁，斯托里挺身而出，将一记低而重的点球越过门将，帮助蓝军晋级。切尔西已进入女子全国联赛杯第二轮抽签。抽签将于 11 月 4 日星期三晚上 7 点举行，并将在 FA WNL YouTube 频道上播出。蓝军将于 11 月 4 日星期三重返 PGA Division 1 比赛，届时桑德兰将前往科巴姆。切尔西（3-4-3）：维多利亚·鲁兹；克洛伊·萨尔维 (Chloe Sarwie)、加比·斯托里 (Gabi Storey)、佐伊·西卡迪尼 (Zoe Ciccardini)；贝尔·沙利文 (c)、凯拉·约翰逊、切尔西·恩德林、洛拉·布朗；丽贝卡·皮尔斯 (Aysia Matabaro 60)、卡拉·加德纳 (Stevie Sinclair 60)、内莉·拉斯未上场替补：弗雷亚·威克斯、安妮·博伊查特、索菲·利奇、泰丝·芬恩、贾米亚·普特曼得分者：加德纳 27 点球：布朗（得分）、恩德林（得分）、辛克莱（失手）、拉斯(得分), Storey (得分) 主教练: Leanne Champ

news.title: Lavia on Hazard: ‘I could see in his eyes he was happy for me’
news.title_zh: 拉维亚谈阿扎尔：“我可以从他的眼睛里看到他为我感到高兴”
news.body_en: Not long after the dust had settled on our win over Manchester United on Saturday, a very special guest waited to greet the Chelsea players before they headed home. Eden Hazard was stationed just outside the tunnel at Stamford Bridge having watched his former club triumph courtesy of goals from Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer. Our brilliant former attacker was especially excited to meet Palmer, who now adorns the No.10 shirt with similar skill and verve as Hazard did, but also his compatriots Mike Penders and Romeo Lavia, both of whom had starred in the game. Lavia has enjoyed his start to the campaign, which has included a return to the Belgium national team. He was thrilled to speak to Hazard, a bona fide Chelsea and Red Devils great who he hopes to emulate in time. ‘He’s a very important figure for me,’ said Lavia. ‘We speak quite a lot. It was good to see him out here, and I could see in his eyes he was happy for me and proud. It gives me that extra motivation.’ For Lavia, it has been a season of steady progress. He has been in the matchday squad for every Premier League fixture so far, and last week completed two 90-minute matches in the space of four days. His displays in those games, against Liverpool and Man United, highlighted just what the 22-year-old is capable of. Now he is determined to maintain those levels of performance and his fitness. ‘As long as I feel good, I will do everything possible to help the team get results. I’m feeling good, so I am very happy with my performance. ‘I’m still young and there are a lot of areas I can improve. We try to tick them off during the week. It’s a process. ‘All I can say is the work we are doing with all the people at the club is going well so far. It’s just about keeping it going and hopefully we can continue this way.’ Eden Hazard will be back at the Bridge when Chelsea Legends take on Tottenham on 27 March, with tickets on general sale here now!
news.body_zh: 周六我们战胜曼联的比赛尘埃落定后不久，一位非常特别的客人在切尔西球员回家之前等待着他们。伊登·阿扎尔站在斯坦福桥球员通道外，看着他的前俱乐部凭借摩根·罗杰斯和科尔·帕尔默的进球取得胜利。我们出色的前攻击手特别高兴见到帕尔默，他现在穿着阿扎尔的 10 号球衣，拥有与阿扎尔相似的技巧和活力，还有他的同胞迈克·潘德斯和罗密欧·拉维亚，两人都曾在这场比赛中担任主角。拉维亚的赛季开局很愉快，其中包括重返比利时国家队。他很高兴能与阿扎尔交谈，阿扎尔是一位真正的切尔西和红魔伟大人物，他希望能及时效仿。 “他对我来说是一个非常重要的人物，”拉维亚说。 ‘我们说了很多话。很高兴在这里见到他，我可以从他的眼睛里看到他为我感到高兴和自豪。这给了我额外的动力。”对于拉维亚来说，这是一个稳步进步的赛季。到目前为止，他已经出现在每场英超比赛的比赛日阵容中，上周在四天内完成了两场90分钟的比赛。他在对阵利物浦和曼联的比赛中的表现凸显了这位 22 岁球员的能力。现在他决心保持这样的表现和健康水平。 ‘只要我感觉良好，我就会尽一切努力帮助球队取得成绩。我感觉很好，所以我对自己的表现很满意。 “我还年轻，还有很多地方可以改进。我们尝试在一周内将它们勾选掉。这是一个过程。 “我只能说，到目前为止，我们与俱乐部所有人一起所做的工作进展顺利。只是要保持下去，希望我们能够继续这样下去。” 当切尔西传奇队于 3 月 27 日迎战托特纳姆热刺队时，阿扎尔将重返蓝桥，门票现已全面发售！

news.body_en: It's been a perfect month for Sonia Bompastor and her Chelsea side, with four wins from four in the Women's Super League and Women's Champions League. Now it is time to pick your standout CFCW strike from October! There are plenty of goals to choose from in October, with the Blues netting 14 times across four matches. We started with a 3-0 away win over West Ham United before the international break, and when our players returned from representing their respective nations, we recorded a memorable 6-2 victory over Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge. That was followed by a 3-1 win at Crystal Palace the following weekend, and the month concluded with a 2-0 win against Roma in the Women's Champions League at Plough Lane. Which Chelsea goal in October was your favourite? View the shortlisted strikes above and then submit your vote on the Chelsea Official App, where the winner of the award, presented by Constant Contact, will be revealed in the coming days. Sjoeke Nusken started the move for our first strike of the afternoon in Dagenham, sensing a moment's hesitation from West Ham when they took a free-kick in their own half. The German international stole the ball, strode forward and picked out Malard. The number nine received it with her back to goal, but stood strong, turned and stroked her finish into the bottom corner. Doubling our lead against the Hammers was Walsh. The move began with Alyssa Thompson jinking her way towards goal from the left-hand side before playing a short sideways pass for Wieke Kaptein, who then shifted the ball quickly to Walsh. The experienced midfielder used her tried and tested technique from range to lash the ball into the bottom corner to the delight of the travelling fans. James' second goal in our 6-2 win over Spurs at Stamford Bridge was a solo effort as she sprinted forward on the break to take matters into her own hands for the second time in that match. Breaking free of the backpedalling defenders, she burst into the box on the left and used her low centre of gravity to lean backwards and curl a superb shot into the bottom right-hand corner. While James' goal came courtesy of a delicate touch, second-half substitute Nusken scored with a pile-driver of a shot to give the Spurs 'keeper Lize Kop no chance of making a save. Finding space in the box, the midfielder blasted home with pure conviction, putting us firmly in the driving seat. Hamano came on after half-time against Spurs, and she marked her appearance against her former loan club with a stunning swerving effort from almost 30 yards out. The replays showed just how much the ball moved once it had left her foot, and the goal certainly got the Blues fans off their seats at Stamford Bridge. Known more for her instinctive finishes from inside the penalty area, Malard's second entry on this list came from distance. As the space opened up 25 yards out following a Katie McCabe throw-in, Malard found herself in space and unleashed a stunning strike that fizzed past a helpless Pauline Peyraud-Magnin in the Palace goal. Click here to visit the Chelsea Official App and cast your vote now!
news.body_zh: 对于索尼娅·邦帕斯特和她的切尔西队来说，这是完美的一个月，在女子超级联赛和女子冠军联赛中取得了四场胜利。现在是时候挑选 10 月份最出色的 CFCW 罢工了！ 10 月份有很多进球可供选择，蓝军在四场比赛中攻入 14 个进球。在国际比赛日之前，我们客场3-0战胜了西汉姆联队，当我们的球员代表各自的国家队归来后，我们在斯坦福桥以6-2击败了托特纳姆热刺队，取得了令人难忘的胜利。接下来的周末，球队以 3-1 战胜水晶宫，并在本月于普劳巷举行的女子冠军联赛中以 2-0 战胜罗马队结束了这个月的比赛。切尔西十月份的哪个进球是你最喜欢的？查看上面入围的进球，然后在切尔西官方应用程序上提交您的投票，由 Constant Contact 颁发的奖项获奖者将在未来几天内揭晓。斯乔克·努斯肯为我们下午在达格纳姆的第一次进球发起了进攻，他感觉到西汉姆联队在本方半场开出任意球时犹豫了片刻。这位德国国脚断球，大步向前，挑出了马拉德。九号球员背对球门接球，但她坚强地站了起来，转身将球射入球门底角。沃尔什（Walsh）使我们对铁锤队的领先优势扩大了一倍。这一举动始于阿丽莎·汤普森从左侧猛冲向球门，然后向维克·卡普坦进行短侧传球，后者迅速将球传给沃尔什。这位经验丰富的中场球员运用她久经考验的远距离技术将球射入底角，让远道而来的球迷们欣喜不已。我们在斯坦福桥 6-2 战胜热刺的比赛中，詹姆斯的第二个进球是她个人的进球，她在中场休息时向前冲刺，在那场比赛中第二次将比赛掌握在自己手中。她挣脱了后退的防守队员，冲入左侧禁区，利用自己的低重心向后倾斜，将一记精彩的射门打入右下角。虽然詹姆斯的进球来自于细腻的触球，但下半场替补出场的努斯肯一脚大力射门，让马刺队的门将莉泽·科普没有机会扑救。这位中场球员在禁区内找到了空间，以纯粹的信念破门得分，让我们牢牢占据了主导地位。滨野在对阵热刺的比赛中场休息后登场，她在对阵她的前租借俱乐部的比赛中以一记令人惊叹的近 30 码外的转身射门标志着自己的出场。回放显示了球一旦离开她的脚就会移动多少，而这个进球无疑让斯坦福桥的蓝军球迷离开了座位。马拉德因其在禁区内本能的射门而闻名，这份名单上的第二个进球来自远距离射门。凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 掷界外球后，当空间打开 25 码时，马拉德 (Malard) 发现自己处于空间中，并射出一脚惊人的射门，飞过了水晶宫球门内无助的保琳·佩罗·马宁 (Pauline Peyraud-Magnin)。单击此处访问切尔西官方应用程序并立即投票！

news.title: Chelsea and Linglong Tire bring The Famous CFC back to China

news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club and global partner Linglong Tire today announce the latest stop for The Famous CFC. The club, including legendary captain Cesar Azpilicueta, will be in Chengdu, China, from 4-6 December for a special fan event ahead of our Premier League fixture against Liverpool. With support from Linglong Tire, this will be the club’s third visit to China for the Famous CFC, following trips to Shanghai and Chongqing. During those visits, Blues legends Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink and Gianfranco Zola met Chelsea supporters in China, who always give the club a warm welcome. Joining Chelsea FC in Chengdu will be club legend Azpilicueta, who will spend the weekend meeting supporters and sharing stories from his decorated career in blue. The Famous CFC is Chelsea's global fan engagement programme, created to deepen connections with Blues supporters around the world and bring the club closer to our international fanbase. Since launching in 2023, the programme has visited cities across Asia, North America and beyond, giving fans unique opportunities to celebrate their shared passion for Chelsea. Fans attending The Famous CFC in Chengdu can look forward to: A live watch party for Chelsea's Premier League clash against Liverpool An exclusive Q&A session with Cesar Azpilicueta A special photo opportunity with the Premier League trophy Opportunities to win signed Chelsea merchandise Additional entertainment and fan activities throughout the event Presented alongside Linglong Tire, the event will celebrate the passionate Blues family in China and provide supporters with the chance to come together for an unforgettable weekend with fellow fans. Register your interest in the event by clicking here, with further details to follow soon. T&Cs apply
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部和全球合作伙伴玲珑轮胎今天宣布了 The Famous CFC 的最新站点。包括传奇队长塞萨尔·阿斯皮利奎塔在内的俱乐部将于 12 月 4 日至 6 日在中国成都参加一场特别的球迷活动，在我们对阵利物浦的英超联赛之前。在玲珑轮胎的支持下，这将是俱乐部继上海和重庆之后，第三次代表CFC访华。在这些访问期间，蓝军传奇人物吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克和吉安弗兰科·佐拉会见了中国的切尔西球迷，他们始终对俱乐部表示热烈欢迎。俱乐部传奇人物阿兹皮利奎塔将在成都加盟切尔西足球俱乐部，他将在周末与球迷会面，并分享他辉煌的蓝色职业生涯的故事。 Famous CFC 是切尔西的全球球迷参与计划，旨在加深与世界各地蓝军支持者的联系，拉近俱乐部与国际球迷的距离。自 2023 年启动以来，该计划已访问亚洲、北美及其他地区的城市，为球迷提供了独特的机会来庆祝他们对切尔西的共同热情。在成都参加 The Famous CFC 的球迷可以期待： 切尔西对阵利物浦的英超联赛现场观看派对 与塞萨尔·阿兹皮利奎塔的独家问答环节 与英超奖杯合影的特别机会 有机会赢得切尔西签名商品 整个活动期间的其他娱乐和球迷活动 与玲珑轮胎一起举办，该活动将庆祝中国热情的蓝军大家庭，并为支持者提供与其他球迷一起度过难忘周末的机会。请点击此处注册您对该活动的兴趣，更多详细信息即将发布。条款与条件适用

news.title: OTD: The Blues run riot in Rome
news.title_zh: OTD：蓝军在罗马发生骚乱
news.body_en: A new-look Chelsea team announced their European credentials with a 4-0 thrashing of Lazio on this day in 2003. The Blues, with plenty of exciting new players in the side, had started our second Champions League campaign solidly, if unspectacularly. We had bagged a late winner against Sparta in Prague before losing at home to Besiktas. A come-from-behind victory against Lazio followed at Stamford Bridge before the teams reconvened in Rome a fortnight later. Nearly 50,000 people packed inside the Stadio Olimpico, including several thousand travelling Chelsea supporters. They witnessed a masterclass from Claudio Ranieri's side. Hernan Crespo, a serial scorer in Serie A before his move to Chelsea, bundled us ahead on the quarter-hour mark, and our cause was made easier early in the second half when Sinisa Mihajlovic was eventually dismissed. We made our numerical advantage count in style, picking off the Roman side with three goals in ten minutes. Eidur Gudjohnsen, Damien Duff and Frank Lampard were the scorers, sealing a victory that made Europe sit up and take notice. We would eventually reach the semi-finals before being agonisingly knocked out by Monaco. You can watch highlights of the famous Lazio win and the story of a memorable second Champions League campaign below.
news.body_zh: 2003 年的这一天，一支面貌焕然一新的切尔西队以 4-0 击败拉齐奥队的方式宣布了他们的欧洲资格。蓝军拥有大量令人兴奋的新球员，尽管表现并不引人注目，但他们已经稳健地开始了我们的第二次欧冠之旅。我们在布拉格对阵斯巴达的比赛中取得了最后的胜利，然后又在主场输给了贝西克塔斯。随后在斯坦福桥逆转战胜拉齐奥，两周后两队在罗马重聚。奥林匹克体育场内挤满了近 5 万人，其中包括数千名随队而来的切尔西球迷。他们见证了克劳迪奥·拉涅利的大师级表演。埃尔南·克雷斯波（Hernan Crespo）在转会切尔西之前是意甲联赛的连续得分手，他在四分之一小时内将我们领先，下半场初期，当西尼萨·米哈伊洛维奇（Sinisa Mihajlovic）最终被罚下时，我们的目标变得更加容易。我们以风格发挥了人数优势，在十分钟内以三个进球击败了罗马队。埃杜尔·古德约翰森、达米安·达夫和弗兰克·兰帕德是进球者，他们锁定了一场让欧洲刮目相看的胜利。我们最终进入了半决赛，然后被摩纳哥痛苦地淘汰了。您可以在下面观看拉齐奥著名胜利的精彩集锦以及令人难忘的第二次欧冠联赛的故事。

news.title: Not On Our Pitch: Chelsea FC Women and Flo show period shame the Pink Card
news.title_zh: 不在我们的球场上：切尔西女足和弗洛表演时期羞辱了粉红卡
news.body_en: Chelsea FC Women and Here We Flo are back for year two of our partnership with Not On Our Pitch. The campaign calls out the everyday habits period shame teaches us, and shows them the Pink Card. The tampon up the sleeve. The cough to cover a crinkling wrapper. The whispered ‘have you got a spare…you know?’ Period shame teaches menstruators to hide something half the population experiences every month. According to the Youth Sport Trust, periods are the single biggest barrier to sport for teenage girls (up to 52%). Every hidden product or whispered phrase reinforces the stigma. To tackle period shame, Chelsea FC Women and Here We Flo, the period care brand which is CFCW's back of short partner, are launching year two of our partnership with a new campaign, Not On Our Pitch, giving the 'pink card' to period shame in football and beyond. Giulia Mazzia, Chelsea FC Women's Chief Revenue Officer, said: 'As a club, we are committed to using our platform to drive conversations that matter, and tackling period shame is one of them. Through our partnership with Here We Flo, we want to challenge the stigma that still surrounds menstruation, confront uncomfortable truths and encourage more open, honest conversations. 'This partnership goes far beyond visibility on our players' shorts. It reflects how we show up every day as a club, using our voice to help create a future where the next generation no longer carries the burden of period shame. We are grateful to Here We Flo for sharing that ambition and helping us drive meaningful change.' Susan Allen-Augustin, co-founder, Here We Flo, added: ‘Last season, We Don’t Bleed Blue achieved 1.6 billion in global press reach. This year, we’re going further, calling out the behaviours that let period shame thrive, on and off the pitch. With Chelsea FC Women now at home at Stamford Bridge, it is the perfect moment to set new standards for the game and beyond.’ A red card sends a player off the pitch, but a pink card sends off period shame. Behaviours like hiding a tampon up your sleeve, whispering about your period, or replying on euphemisms 'like time of the month' no longer have a place in the game. Here We Flo and Chelsea Women Players will address period shame on social media, stadium screens and matchday programmes, tackling myths alongside gynaecologists. Just as referees send off foul play, players and fans can use the Flo Pink Card to call out period shame habits whenever they spot it.
news.body_zh: 切尔西女足和 Here We Flo 与 Not On Our Pitch 合作已进入第二年。该活动唤起了我们在羞耻时期教给我们的日常习惯，并向他们展示了粉红卡。将卫生棉条塞在袖子上。咳嗽盖住皱巴巴的包装纸。人们低声说“你有备用的吗……你知道吗？”经期耻辱教会月经者隐藏一半人口每月经历的事情。根据青年体育信托基金的数据，经期是少女运动的最大障碍（高达 52%）。每一个隐藏的产品或低声的短语都会强化这种耻辱。为了解决经期耻辱问题，切尔西足球俱乐部女足和 CFCW 短期合作伙伴支持的经期护理品牌 Here We Flo 在合作的第二年启动了一项新活动“Not On Our Pitch”，为足球界及其他领域的经期耻辱颁发“粉红卡”。切尔西足球俱乐部女足首席营收官朱莉娅·马齐亚 (Giulia Mazzia) 表示：“作为一个俱乐部，我们致力于利用我们的平台推动重要的对话，解决经期耻辱就是其中之一。通过与 Here We Flo 的合作，我们希望挑战仍然围绕月经的耻辱，面对令人不安的事实并鼓励更开放、诚实的对话。 “这种合作关系远远超出了我们球员短裤的可见度。它反映了我们作为一个俱乐部每天如何表现，用我们的声音帮助创造一个未来，让下一代不再背负时代耻辱的负担。我们感谢 Here We Flo 分享这一雄心并帮助我们推动有意义的变革。 Here We Flo 联合创始人苏珊·艾伦-奥古斯汀 (Susan Allen-Augustin) 补充道：“上一季，《We Don’t Bleed Blue》的全球媒体覆盖率达到了 16 亿。今年，我们将更进一步，指出那些让经期耻辱在球场内外盛行的行为。切尔西女足现在坐镇斯坦福桥主场，现在是为比赛及其他比赛制定新标准的最佳时刻。一张红牌会导致一名球员离开球场，但一张粉红牌会导致一段时期的耻辱。像把卫生棉条藏在袖子里、窃窃私语你的经期或回答“每月的时间”这样的委婉说法等行为在游戏中不再占有一席之地。在这里，我们弗洛和切尔西女球员将在社交媒体、体育场屏幕和比赛日节目中解决经期耻辱问题，与妇科医生一起解决神话。正如裁判会判罚犯规一样，球员和球迷只要发现这种耻辱习惯，就可以使用 Flo 粉红卡来指出这种行为。

news.title: Giulia Dragoni: 'I want young Italian girls to dream of playing for Chelsea'
news.title_zh: 朱利亚·德拉戈尼：“我希望年轻的意大利女孩梦想为切尔西效力”
news.body_en: Summer signing Giulia Dragoni couldn't hold back her emotions when her shot hit the back of the net during our 6-0 win over Charlton Athletic at the weekend, and it's no wonder her eyes were filled with tears. Still only 19 and navigating a move away from her home country, the Italian midfielder has fought for minutes this season amid strong competition in her position. Sonia Bompastor has praised her strong mentality and determination to improve, explaining how the youngster continually asks for feedback on her performance. The head coach is confident more playing time will come, and Dragoni did her chances no harm by scoring her first competitive goal for Chelsea after being introduced as a second-half substitute against Charlton. Yet it was matters off the pitch that were on the agenda when we sat down to talk to her, and it appears she's settling well in her new home. 'It’s been really nice since I moved here,' she smiles. 'It's already been three months. I came here, and I didn't know what to expect from my team-mates, to be honest. Of course, I knew Keira (Walsh) and Lucy (Bronze) from Barcelona, but I was really young then; I was a little kid. Now I'm a bit different as a person and a player. 'Everyone, since the first day, has helped me a lot to adapt better to the language, to the training, to a different kind of football. They are trying to make me feel as comfortable as they can, and I'm really enjoying my time here. 'I really enjoyed our tour to Australia and New Zealand; it was a nice first few weeks. Since then, I’ve been learning every day in training and trying to take in everything that I can from the other players. My English is improving, but I think I can get better. 'Of the three languages that I can speak (Italian, Spanish and English), English is the one that I speak the worst. But I'm happy, and I'm watching a lot of series in English to learn better.' Back home in Italy, the spotlight has been on Dragoni's move to Chelsea. There, the women's game is still developing, so to see a young talent make the move to a side with multiple trophies and big ambitions has been a big deal. Dragoni is not the kind of player to let such attention go to her head, and is instead content with the thought she might be making a difference as a role model to aspiring young players back home. 'I like to think about myself as a normal, almost 20-year-old girl,' she continues. 'I'm happy that little girls from Italy are thinking about me as a kind of inspiration, you know? 'I hope that some of these little girls can now dream of being at Chelsea if they really want to one day, and if they keep working hard, nothing is impossible. But I want to keep my feet on the ground. I'm that kind of person.' The teenager is no stranger to living in big cities. Born in Milan, she earned a move to Barcelona in January 2023, before spending two seasons on loan at Roma in Italy's capital. And while she is now enjoying London, her patriotism shines through when asked to compare the UK capital with Rome. 'Rome is really nice. I think it's one of the best cities in the world, to be honest,' she says. 'Once you’ve lived there, it's really hard to compare Rome to other cities. As an Italian, I really love Rome, but I'm enjoying London so far as well, even if the weather is not the best! 'I'm maybe more of a country girl now. I think I’m a bit tired of too many people. We have nice parks and areas where we can walk near the training ground. That's the part I'm enjoying the most: being a bit calmer and having time on my own for a bit.' Saturday's match with Everton at Stamford Bridge coincides with Dragoni's 20th birthday, and she shares her special day with Alyssa Thompson, who will turn 22 on 7 November. The Italian is looking forward to the celebrations for one particular reason. She said: 'It’s good, because I don't want to have all the attention on me, so we can share it!'
news.body_zh: 周末我们6-0战胜查尔顿队的比赛中，夏季签约球员朱莉娅·德拉戈尼的射门击中球网后，她无法抑制自己的情绪，难怪她的眼里充满了泪水。这位意大利中场球员年仅 19 岁，正在远离祖国，本赛季在位置上的激烈竞争中，她已经争取了上场时间。索尼娅·邦帕斯特赞扬了她坚强的心态和不断进步的决心，并解释了这位年轻人如何不断寻求有关她表现的反馈。主教练相信会有更多的上场时间，德拉格尼在对阵查尔顿的下半场替补出场后打进了她在切尔西的第一个正式进球，这也没有伤害到她的机会。然而，当我们坐下来与她交谈时，球场外的事情才被提上议程，看来她在新家安顿得很好。 “自从我搬到这里以来，情况真的很好，”她微笑着说。 ‘已经三个月了。我来到这里，说实话，我不知道对我的队友有什么期望。当然，我认识来自巴塞罗那的凯拉（沃尔什）和露西（青铜），但那时我真的很年轻；我还是个小孩子。现在我作为一个人和一个球员有点不同。 “从第一天起，每个人都帮助我更好地适应语言、训练和不同类型的足球。他们尽力让我感到舒适，我真的很享受在这里的时光。 “我真的很喜欢我们的澳大利亚和新西兰之旅；最初的几周过得很愉快。从那时起，我每天都在训练中学习，并努力从其他球员那里吸取一切。我的英语正在进步，但我想我可以变得更好。 “在我会说的三种语言（意大利语、西班牙语和英语）中，英语是我说得最差的一种。但我很高兴，而且我正在观看很多英语系列节目，以便学得更好。”回到意大利家乡，人们关注的焦点一直是德拉格尼转会切尔西。在那里，女子比赛仍在发展中，因此看到一位年轻天才转会到一支拥有多个奖杯和雄心勃勃的球队是一件大事。德拉格尼不是那种让这种关注冲昏头脑的球员，相反，她对自己可能成为家乡有抱负的年轻球员的榜样而感到满意。 “我喜欢把自己想象成一个正常的、快 20 岁的女孩，”她继续说道。 “我很高兴来自意大利的小女孩认为我是一种灵感，你知道吗？ “我希望这些小女孩中的一些现在能够梦想进入切尔西，如果她们真的想有一天，并且如果她们继续努力，没有什么是不可能的。但我想脚踏实地。我就是这样的人。这个少年对大城市的生活并不陌生。她出生于米兰，于 2023 年 1 月转会至巴塞罗那，然后在意大利首都罗马租借了两个赛季。虽然她现在很享受伦敦，但当被问及将英国首都与罗马进行比较时，她的爱国主义表现得淋漓尽致。 “罗马真的很好。说实话，我认为这是世界上最好的城市之一，”她说。 “一旦你住在那里，就很难将罗马与其他城市进行比较。作为一个意大利人，我真的很喜欢罗马，但到目前为止我也很喜欢伦敦，即使天气不是最好的！ “我现在可能更像一个乡下姑娘了。我想我有点厌倦了太多的人。我们在训练场附近有漂亮的公园和可以散步的区域。这是我最喜欢的部分：稍微平静一点，有一点属于自己的时间。”周六在斯坦福桥对阵埃弗顿的比赛恰逢德拉格尼的 20 岁生日，她与艾莉莎·汤普森 (Alyssa Thompson) 一起度过了这个特殊的日子，后者将于 11 月 7 日迎来 22 岁生日。意大利人出于一个特殊的原因期待着庆祝活动。她说：“这很好，因为我不想让所有的注意力都集中在我身上，所以我们可以分享！”

news.title: Vote for Chelsea’s October Goal of the Month

news.body_en: There was no shortage of superb Chelsea goals scored in October, and now we want you to choose the best of the bunch. Grimwade whipped a stunning free-kick into the top left-hand corner, the dip and swerve on the ball too hot for the visiting keeper to handle. Henderson opened his Chelsea account a couple of minutes into his home debut in style, bending a wonderful finish into the Shed End net via the inside of the post. Joao Pedro’s first of the afternoon stemmed from good work from Pedro Neto down the right, before the Brazilian instinctively fired home a right-footed finish into the roof of the Bournemouth net. Henderson’s afternoon got even better when he bagged his second of the afternoon, curling a free-kick into the top right-hand corner with Djordje Petrovic helpless to stop it. Strong hold-up play from Morgan Rogers allowed Jorrel Hato to dart down the left flank, beating his man before finding Neto in the middle, who stroked his finish into the net to give us the lead at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. Pennie darted from inside his own half, evading one sliding challenge before running in on goal and calmly finishing on his right. Grimwade’s second nomination is for an almost carbon copy of his first: a postage-stamp free-kick perfectly placed against Ipswich at Cobham. Greenwood equalised in the first leg of our UEFA Youth League second round tie with a powerful 18-yard strike that flew into the net after he had cut inside and created space for a shot. A brilliant recovery and pass from Romeo Lavia freed Rogers, who needed no second invitation to drive at the Man United backline. With space opening up, Rogers dribbled through the heart of the visitors’ defence before dinking the ball into the net to put us 1-0 up. Vote for your favourite on the Chelsea Official App!

news.title: Cole Palmer and the four other fastest Blues to 50 Premier League goals
news.title_zh: 科尔·帕尔默（Cole Palmer）和其他四位最快打入 50 个英超进球的蓝军球员
news.body_en: The penalty Cole Palmer converted against Manchester United was his 50th Premier League goal for Chelsea. It is a landmark the Blues' No.10 has quickly reached. The 24-year-old is the third-quickest player in Blues history to reach a half-century of goals in the Premier League era. Palmer has needed just 105 games to do it, with his spot-kick on Saturday his third league goal of the campaign. We list below our top five fastest players to 50 Premier League goals, with Palmer in esteemed company among some of the best attackers in our history. Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink hit the ground running at Stamford Bridge after arriving from Atletico Madrid for a club-record fee. The Dutch striker brought up his 50th Premier League goal in just 84 Blues appearances, with 23 alone in his debut season when he won the Golden Boot award. Diego Costa was the focal point of two Premier League title wins, in 2015 and 2017. The Spanish international reached the 50-goal mark for us in 85 matches, midway through his third and final campaign as a Blue, when he again finished as our top scorer. Palmer’s ratio of almost a goal every other game in the Premier League for the Blues is a phenomenal achievement considering – unlike the other players in this list – he is not a striker. An amazing 22 goals in his maiden campaign set the tone for what was to come. Always a player for the big occasion, Didier Drogba's legendary Chelsea career included 104 Premier League goals, the first 50 of which came in 106 appearances. His goals helped fire us to the Premier League title in 2005, 2006, 2010 and 2015. Signed from Bolton Wanderers in 2000, Eidur Gudjohnsen quickly became a fan favourite with his intelligence, silky touch, and knack for spectacular goals. The Icelandic forward completed the half-century in 153 Premier League outings, playing a crucial role in our back-to-back title successes in the mid-2000s.
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默在对阵曼联的比赛中罚入点球，这是他为切尔西攻入的第 50 个英超进球。这是蓝军十号球员很快就达到的一个里程碑。这位24岁的球员是蓝军历史上英超时代半个世纪进球第三快的球员。帕尔默只用了 105 场比赛就做到了这一点，周六的点球是他本赛季的第三个联赛进球。下面我们列出了英超联赛进球速度最快的五名球员，其中帕尔默是我们历史上最好的攻击手之一。吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克 (Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink) 从马德里竞技以创俱乐部纪录的转会费加盟斯坦福桥后，便开始了自己的职业生涯。这位荷兰前锋在为蓝军出场的84场比赛中攻入了他的第50个英超进球，其中在他获得金靴奖的首个赛季中就打入了23个进球。迭戈·科斯塔是 2015 年和 2017 年两次赢得英超联赛冠军的焦点。这位西班牙国脚在 85 场比赛中为我们打进了 50 个进球，这是他作为蓝军的第三个也是最后一个赛季的中期，当时他再次成为我们的最佳射手。帕尔默在英超联赛中为蓝军几乎每隔一场比赛就有一个进球的比率是一个惊人的成就，考虑到与名单上的其他球员不同，他不是前锋。他在处子赛季就打进了惊人的 22 粒进球，为接下来的比赛定下了基调。迪迪埃·德罗巴始终是重要场合的球员，他传奇的切尔西生涯包括 104 个英超进球，其中前 50 个进球是在 106 场比赛中打进的。他的进球帮助我们在 2005 年、2006 年、2010 年和 2015 年夺得英超冠军。埃杜尔·古德约翰森于 2000 年从博尔顿队签约，凭借他的聪明才智、柔滑的触感和精彩进球的技巧，他很快成为球迷的最爱。这位冰岛前锋在半个世纪中出场 153 场英超联赛，为我们在 2000 年代中期连续夺冠发挥了至关重要的作用。

news.title: Seven standout stats from Chelsea's win over Manchester United
news.title_zh: 切尔西战胜曼联的七项出色数据
news.body_en: A dominant second-half performance from the Blues secured a 2-0 victory over Manchester United on Saturday and returned us to the Premier League's top four. And here are seven standout statistics from our win at Stamford Bridge. Cole Palmer scored his 50th Premier League goal for Chelsea on his 105th appearance. He's the third-fastest to reach that milestone for the Blues, after Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink (84 games) and Diego Costa (85 games). The Blues have netted nine goals in the opening five minutes of either half in the Premier League this season. No other team has scored more than three, while only in 2008/09 (10) and 2024/25 (11) have the Blues netted more such goals. Morgan Rogers became the first Chelsea player and just the second Premier League player to reach 10 goal involvements in all competitions this season (six goals, four assists), after Erling Haaland. Rogers’ five league goals make him our top scorer in the competition. Romeo Lavia won possession 14 times against Manchester United, the most by a Chelsea player in a Premier League game since Lewis Hall did so at Fulham in January 2023. It is also the joint-most by any player in the top flight this season, alongside Ipswich Town’s Argentine international midfielder Exequiel Palacios against Nottingham Forest. The Blues have kept two clean sheets in our last three Premier League games, one more than in our previous 28 matches in the competition. They were also Mike Penders’ first Premier League clean sheets, having played the last 15 minutes at Everton and the full 90 minutes against Manchester United, both 2-0 wins. Chelsea won a Premier League home game without conceding for the first time in 13 matches, since a 2-0 victory against Brentford in January. On Saturday, at 23 years and 89 days, we named our joint-second-youngest starting XI in a Premier League match, matching the age of the line-up that faced Newcastle United in October 2024. The 23 years and 21 days of the team that beat Crystal Palace 2-1 in December 2023 remains our youngest of all time in the Premier League.
news.body_zh: 周六，蓝军凭借下半场的统治性表现以 2-0 战胜曼联，重返英超前四。以下是我们在斯坦福桥获胜的七项出色统计数据。科尔·帕尔默在代表切尔西出场的第 105 场比赛中攻入了他的第 50 粒英超进球。他是蓝军达到这一里程碑的第三快球员，仅次于吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克（84 场比赛）和迭戈·科斯塔（85 场比赛）。本赛季英超联赛中，蓝军在上下半场开场五分钟内就攻入了九个进球。没有其他球队进球超过 3 球，而只有 2008/09 赛季（10 球）和 2024/25 赛季（11 球）蓝军取得了更多这样的进球。摩根·罗杰斯成为首位切尔西球员，也是继埃尔林·哈兰德之后第二位在本赛季所有比赛中打入 10 粒进球（6 粒进球、4 次助攻）的英超球员。罗杰斯的五个联赛进球使他成为本次比赛的最佳射手。罗密欧·拉维亚在对阵曼联的比赛中赢得控球权 14 次，这是自刘易斯·霍尔 2023 年 1 月在富勒姆赢得控球权以来，切尔西球员在英超比赛中获得控球权最多的球员。这也是本赛季顶级联赛球员中获得控球权最多的球员，与伊普斯维奇镇队的阿根廷国脚埃克塞奎尔·帕拉西奥斯并列对阵诺丁汉森林队的比赛中。蓝军在过去三场英超比赛中保持了两场不失球，比我们之前的 28 场比赛多了一场。这也是迈克·潘德斯在英超联赛中首次零失球，他在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中打满了最后15分钟，在对阵曼联的比赛中打满了90分钟，两场比赛均以2-0获胜。切尔西自一月份2-0战胜布伦特福德以来，在13场比赛中首次取得英超主场不失球的成绩。周六，我们以 23 岁零 89 天的年龄确定了英超比赛中并列第二年轻的首发阵容，与 2024 年 10 月对阵纽卡斯尔联队的阵容年龄相匹配。2023 年 12 月以 2-1 击败水晶宫的球队的年龄为 23 岁零 21 天，仍然是我们在英超联赛中最年轻的首发阵容。

news.title: Analysis: Midfield engine and fluid forward line too much for Man United
news.title_zh: 分析：中场发动机和流畅的前锋线对曼联来说太多了
news.body_en: The Blues returned to the Premier League’s top four after overcoming Manchester United at Stamford Bridge. We dive into the post-match statistics to detail how Romeo Lavia’s starring role and our rotating attackers left our opponents beaten. After an evenly balanced first half, the Blues came flying out of the blocks in the second period - not for the first time this season - and Morgan Rogers broke the deadlock with his fifth Premier League goal of the season, making him our top scorer in the competition and the first Chelsea player to reach 10 goal involvements across all competitions. And after Manchester United were reduced to 10 men following a second booking for Lisandro Martinez for a foul on Wesley Fofana, and Cole Palmer swept in the resulting penalty for his 50th Premier League goal for the club, we were able to finish the job in relative comfort with a dominant second-half display. Lavia was voted Player of the Match by supporters on the Chelsea Official App – and it is not hard to see why. The Belgian dominated the midfield on Saturday, covering ground and stepping in with perfect timing to snuff out opposition attacks before they could gain momentum and producing counter-attacking opportunities. The clearest example of that came shortly after half-time, when he created the chance for Rogers to open the scoring. As Bryan Mbeumo tried to shield the ball in the centre-circle, Lavia overpowered him and then reacted quickly to beat Carlos Baleba to the second ball and direct it into Rogers’ feet. The midfielder was also unlucky not to get a second assist when he demonstrated his excellent reading of the game, racing out of nowhere to anticipate a Bruno Fernandes first-time pass and intercept, before sending Palmer running against the United backline. It turned defence into attack in an instant and ended with Estevao Willian firing into the roof of the net, although the goal would be chalked off for the narrowest of VAR offside calls. The Belgian’s five tackles were the most of any player on the pitch and he came away with the ball from four of them. Overall, he regained possession 14 times, not only the highest number in this match, but the most by any Chelsea player in a single fixture for over three-and-a-half years. It's also telling that 12 of those 14 recoveries came in the opposition half and two of them in the Man Utd penalty area. Lavia didn't just sit back and protect our defence; he actively hunted the ball down to win it back from positions that we could threaten our opponents with a quick turnover. Of course, taking advantage of transitions instigated by ball-winners such as Lavia is easier when you have attacking players who can ruthlessly punish opponents. Although Rogers was not far off the halfway line when he received the ball, the way he advanced with purpose towards the hesitant defenders made the goal seem almost inevitable. It was a team effort from our forward line against Manchester United, though. Pedro Neto took on the central striker’s role in Joao Pedro’s absence and did so selflessly, holding up the ball and using his movement to create space for Rogers and Estevao to exploit coming into the channels from wide, while Palmer pulled the strings between the lines. The effect was devastating, as our attack has been so often this season under Xabi Alonso. In total, the Blues managed 19 shots against Man Utd, our highest in a single Premier League match this season. Estevao led the way by providing six of those, also the joint-highest by a Chelsea player in the league this season, in addition to his two goals disallowed. Estevao, Palmer and Rogers all tied for the most chances created in the game, with three each, and also made up the leading three for passes completed in the final third. It was Palmer who topped that particular statistic, completing an impressive 19 of 25 passes in the final third, both game-high numbers. Saturday's match underlined how much Palmer and Rogers love playing against Man Utd. The ex-Manchester City academy duo both have excellent records against their old local rivals: Palmer with five goals in eight games, Rogers with three goals in five games. Further back, Josh Acheampong again showed how he has adapted to life in the Premier League this season. The Academy graduate has been a regular in Alonso’s team, featuring in all but one of our nine league games so far, and continues to produce performances that defy his age and experience. With the movement of our attackers pulling the Man Utd defenders narrow, Acheampong was able to dominate the right flank. He kept Matheus Cunha largely in check while galloping forward to add width to our attacks at the other end. Defensively, only Lavia bettered the 20-year-old’s three successful tackles and 10 ball recoveries, while in possession only Fofana had more than his 90 touches of the ball. In addition, Acheampong’s 12 completed passes in the final third were only behind the attacking trio of Estevao, Palmer and Rogers, and more than any United player apart from Bruno Fernandes. A true all-round performance from our young right-back.
news.body_zh: 蓝军在斯坦福桥击败曼联后重返英超前四。我们深入研究赛后统计数据，详细了解罗密欧·拉维亚的主角和我们的轮换攻击手如何击败对手。上半场双方势均力敌后，蓝军在下半场突围而出——这并不是本赛季第一次——摩根·罗杰斯凭借本赛季的第五个英超进球打破了僵局，使他成为我们在比赛中的最佳射手，也是第一位在所有比赛中进球数达到 10 的切尔西球员。利桑德罗·马丁内斯因对韦斯利·福法纳犯规而吃到第二张黄牌，曼联队的人数减少到 10 人，科尔·帕尔默主罚点球，打入他为俱乐部攻入的第 50 粒英超进球，之后我们凭借下半场的统治性表现，相对轻松地完成了任务。拉维亚在切尔西官方应用程序上被球迷评选为本场最佳球员——原因不难理解。比利时人在周六的中场占据了统治地位，他在完美的时机掩护并介入，在对手获得动力并创造反击机会之前扼杀了对手的进攻。最明显的例子出现在半场结束后不久，当时他为罗杰斯创造了首开纪录的机会。当布莱恩·姆博莫（Bryan Mbeumo）试图在中圈护球时，拉维亚（Lavia）制服了他，然后迅速做出反应，击败卡洛斯·巴莱巴（Carlos Baleba）拿到第二个球并将其直接传到罗杰斯的脚下。这位中场球员也很不幸地没有获得第二次助攻，因为他展示了自己对比赛的出色解读，不知从何而来，预见到布鲁诺·费尔南德斯的第一次传球和拦截，然后让帕尔默冲向曼联后防线。比赛瞬间变守为攻，最终埃斯特沃·威廉射入网顶，尽管进球因VAR越位判定而被取消。比利时人的五次铲断是场上所有球员中最多的，并且他从其中四次抢断中将球带走。总体而言，他夺回控球权 14 次，不仅是本场比赛中夺回控球权最多的球员，也是三年半以来切尔西球员单场比赛中夺回控球权最多的球员。值得注意的是，这 14 次抢救中有 12 次发生在对方半场，其中 2 次发生在曼联禁区。拉维亚不仅袖手旁观，保护我们的防守；他积极地追球，从我们可以通过快速失误威胁对手的位置夺回球权。当然，当你的进攻球员能够无情地惩罚对手时，利用拉维亚这样的控球手发起的转换会更容易。尽管罗杰斯接球时距离中线不远，但他有目的地向犹豫不决的后卫推进的方式让进球看起来几乎是不可避免的。不过，在对阵曼联的比赛中，这是我们前锋线的团队努力。若昂·佩德罗缺阵期间，佩德罗·内托担当了中锋的角色，他无私地接球，利用自己的跑动为罗杰斯和埃斯特沃创造空间，以便从边路进入通道，而帕尔默则在两条线之间拉动。其影响是毁灭性的，因为本赛季在哈维·阿隆索的带领下我们的进攻非常频繁。蓝军在对阵曼联的比赛中总共射门 19 次，这是本赛季英超单场比赛中射门次数最多的。埃斯特沃以六粒进球领先，这也是本赛季切尔西球员在联赛中并列最高的进球数，此外他还有两粒进球被判无效。埃斯特沃、帕尔默和罗杰斯均创造了本场比赛最多的机会，各有 3 个，并且在最后三分之一的传球成功率上也位列前三。帕尔默在这项统计数据上名列前茅，他在进攻三区的 25 次传球中完成了 19 次，这两项数据都是全场最高的。周六的比赛凸显了帕尔默和罗杰斯对对阵曼联的热爱。这对前曼城青训组合在对阵当地老对手时都取得了出色的战绩：帕尔默在八场比赛中打进五球，罗杰斯在五场比赛中打进三球。再往前看，乔什·阿奇姆蓬再次展示了他如何适应本赛季英超联赛的生活。这位青训毕业生一直是阿隆索球队的常客，到目前为止，除了一场联赛之外，他在我们的九场联赛中都出场了，并且继续创造出与他的年龄和经验相悖的表现。 随着我们攻击手的移动将曼联后卫拉近，阿奇姆蓬能够控制右翼。他在很大程度上控制住了马修斯·库尼亚，同时向前驰骋，为我们在另一端的进攻增加了宽度。在防守方面，只有拉维亚比这位 20 岁球员的 3 次成功铲断和 10 次接球次数更胜一筹，而在控球方面，只有福法纳的触球次数超过了他的 90 次。此外，阿奇姆蓬在进攻三区完成的12次传球仅落后于埃斯特沃、帕尔默和罗杰斯的进攻三人组，超过了除布鲁诺·费尔南德斯之外的任何曼联球员。我们年轻的右后卫真正的全面表现。

news.title: Five Chelsea stars nominated for FIFPRO Women’s World 11
news.title_zh: 五名切尔西球星入围 FIFPRO 女子世界 11 强提名
news.body_en: Aggie Beever-Jones, Lucy Bronze, Ellie Carpenter, Hannah Hampton and Katie McCabe have all been shortlisted for the 2026 FIFPRO Women’s World 11. The prestigious FIFPRO awards are the only global football accolades decided exclusively by players and this year 6,511 women’s footballers from 64 countries have voted for their team of the year, with the Chelsea quintet among the 26 finalists. The XI will be made up of one goalkeeper, three defenders, three midfielders and three strikers, plus the one remaining player with the most votes. The team will be revealed by FIFPRO on Monday 9 November at 1pm UK time, when Beever-Jones, Bronze, Carpenter, Hampton and McCabe will all be hoping to represent Chelsea on the final list. Last season, Bronze made history by being named in the XI for a record eighth time, while Hampton and our former captain Millie Bright were also included in the team of the world's best players in 2025. Congratulations and good luck, Blues!
news.body_zh: 阿吉·比弗-琼斯、露西·布朗兹、埃莉·卡彭特、汉娜·汉普顿和凯蒂·麦凯布均已入围 2026 年 FIFPRO 女子世界 11 强。这一久负盛名的 FIFPRO 奖项是唯一由球员完全决定的全球足球奖项，今年来自 64 个国家的 6,511 名女足运动员投票选出了年度最佳球队，切尔西五人组跻身其中 26 名。决赛入围者。十一人将由一名守门员、三名后卫、三名中场和三名前锋以及剩下的一名得票最多的球员组成。 FIFPRO 将于英国时间 11 月 9 日星期一下午 1 点公布球队名单，届时比弗-琼斯、布隆兹、卡彭特、汉普顿和麦凯布都希望代表切尔西进入最终名单。上赛季，铜牌创造了历史，创纪录地第八次入选首发阵容，而汉普顿和我们的前队长米莉·布莱特也入选了 2025 年世界最佳球员阵容。恭喜你，祝你好运，蓝军！

news.title: Analysis: How Chelsea Women saw off Charlton with quick-fire attack
news.title_zh: 分析：切尔西女足如何通过快速进攻击败查尔顿
news.body_en: When Chelsea made the trip across London to face Charlton Athletic on Sunday, we faced a side with completely different objectives to our own. The Addicks finished third in the Women's Super League 2 last season and earned promotion to the top flight by winning a play-out against relegated Women's Super League side Leicester City as part of the league's objective to increase the WSL to 14 teams. It's been tough for Charlton so far, and they came into Sunday's match without a single point earned in seven matches this season. From a Chelsea perspective, that meant it was imperative to win, especially with us sitting neck-and-neck with Manchester City at the top of the table. Blues head coach Sonia Bompastor has an oft-used phrase when she says she likes her team to score early to 'kill off the opposition's hope'. That's exactly what we did when Nathalie Bjorn netted after three minutes, then a brace from Melvine Malard and a strike by Ellie Carpenter all came before the 20-minute mark. For a newly-promoted team with no points on the board, against an experienced Chelsea side, that was effectively game over, and second-half goals from Aggie Beever-Jones and Giulia Dragoni completed the 6-0 win. Here's a look at how a ruthless approach secured the three points... There was no holding back on Sunday, as the Blues attempted 36 shots against Charlton, our highest total in a single match in the WSL this season. Our assault on the opposition's back line made sure there was no chance for them to dig in and attempt to frustrate us with a low block, and it also allowed us to build our goal difference to plus 23, with the title race looking like it might come down to fine margins this season. Bompastor's earlier call for the team to be more clinical has been answered, as we have scored in all eight of our WSL fixtures this season. No other team has done so. Malard and Chelsea have been the perfect fit since the striker's summer move from Manchester United. The Blues No9 has already equalled her WSL tally of six managed with the Red Devils last season and is thriving up front in her new home. One of the reasons for her superb form could be that she is focusing solely on finding the back of the net. Against Charlton, she netted her brace in the space of just 10 minutes, making a game-changing contribution early on in the match. If a striker scores twice in a game, they need not contribute much else. In a show of attacking efficiency during her 50 minutes of action, Malard touched the ball 13 times, completing all five of her passes and scoring twice from three shots on goal. It is that deadly form that will strike fear into opposition defences in the weeks to come. Another summer signing who has fit like a glove is Katie McCabe. Her high standards ensure that she puts in consistently strong performances every week and she once again stood out during the win over Charlton. Creating more chances (five) than any other player on the pitch, McCabe also ranked second for crosses attempted (six), completed passes (78) and completed passes in the final third (22). Both McCabe and her right-sided counterpart Carpenter were aggressive in winning the ball back, with the Australian ranking highest for recoveries (12) and the Republic of Ireland captain following just behind her with 11. It was another unselfish performance from McCabe and her performances could well continue to improve as the weeks go by at her new club. Chelsea supporters will have been delighted to see Nathalie Bjorn lead the team out as captain at The Valley following her injury-hit season last term. The experienced defender made her first start of the campaign against Charlton and began the match in the best way possible with her early goal. It was an assured display from Bjorn as she played just over an hour in the back line before being replaced by Alyssa Thompson. Having the Sweden international back in form will be a huge boost as the fixtures continue to come thick and fast in the coming weeks.
news.body_zh: 当切尔西周日穿越伦敦迎战查尔顿竞技时，我们面对的是一支与我们目标完全不同的球队。阿迪克斯队上赛季在女足超级联赛 2 中获得第三名，并在附加赛中击败降级的女足超级联赛球队莱斯特城，从而升级到顶级联赛，这是联盟将 WSL 球队增加到 14 支球队的目标的一部分。到目前为止，查尔顿的处境很艰难，他们在本赛季的七场比赛中没有获得一分，进入周日的比赛。从切尔西的角度来看，这意味着获胜势在必行，尤其是在我们与积分榜榜首的曼城并驾齐驱的情况下。蓝军主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特有一句常用的短语，她说她希望她的球队尽早进球，以“扼杀对手的希望”。这正是我们所做的，三分钟后纳塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 进球，梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 梅开二度，埃莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 进球，这一切都在 20 分钟前完成。对于积分榜上没有积分的升班马来说，对阵经验丰富的切尔西队，比赛实际上已经结束，下半场阿吉·比弗-琼斯和朱利亚·德拉戈尼的进球完成了6-0的胜利。让我们看看如何用残酷的手段确保三分……周日，蓝军毫无保留地在对阵查尔顿的比赛中尝试了 36 次射门，这是我们本赛季 WSL 单场比赛的最高射门总数。我们对对手后防线的进攻确保了他们没有机会深入防守并试图用低位拦网来挫败我们，这也让我们将净胜球扩大到了+23，本赛季的冠军争夺战看起来可能会以微弱优势结束。邦帕斯托早些时候要求球队更加冷静的呼吁得到了回应，我们在本赛季 WSL 的全部八场比赛中都取得了进球。没有其他团队这样做过。自从马拉德夏季从曼联转会以来，马拉德和切尔西一直是完美的配合。这位蓝军9号球员已经追平了她上赛季在红魔执教的WSL 6场比赛的成绩，并且在她的新家中正在蓬勃发展。她状态出色的原因之一可能是她只专注于进球。在对阵查尔顿的比赛中，她在仅仅 10 分钟内就梅开二度，在比赛一开始就做出了改变比赛的贡献。如果一名前锋在一场比赛中得分两次，那么他们不需要做出太多其他贡献。马拉德在 50 分钟的比赛中展现了进攻效率，共触球 13 次，完成全部 5 次传球，并 3 次射门得分 2 次。正是这种致命的形式将在未来几周内让对手的防线感到恐惧。另一位夏季签约的球员是凯蒂·麦凯布（Katie McCabe）。她的高标准确保她每周都有持续强劲的表现，并在战胜查尔顿的比赛中再次脱颖而出。麦凯布创造的机会（5次）比球场上任何其他球员都多，他在传中尝试（6次）、传球成功（78次）和最后三分之一传球成功（22次）方面也排名第二。麦凯布和她的右路对手卡彭特在夺回球权方面都表现得很积极，澳大利亚队的抢回球数排名最高（12），爱尔兰共和国队长以 11 次紧随其后。这是麦凯布的又一次无私表现，随着在新俱乐部的几周过去，她的表现很可能会继续提高。切尔西的支持者们将会很高兴看到纳塔莉·比约恩在上赛季受伤后带领球队在山谷球场担任队长。这位经验丰富的后卫在对阵查尔顿的比赛中首次首发，并以早期的进球以最好的方式开始了比赛。比约恩的表现令人放心，她在后防线上踢了一个多小时，然后就被艾莉莎·汤普森换下。随着接下来几周的比赛继续密集而快速，这位瑞典国脚恢复状态将是一个巨大的推动。

news.title: Ellie Carpenter feeling good and taking positives from Charlton win
news.title_zh: 埃莉·卡彭特感觉良好，并从查尔顿的胜利中获得积极的态度
news.body_en: With her fifth goal of the season in our 6-0 victory over Charlton Athletic at the weekend, Ellie Carpenter has already exceeded last season’s total of three. And it’s only November. The wing-back, now in her second campaign with the Blues, has played a key role in the team’s success this season, starting in all but one of our 13 matches so far. Last week, Carpenter came on at half-time against Roma in the Women’s Champions League with the scores locked at 0-0, scoring within six minutes of the restart. After the match, Sonia Bompastor explained there was some debate over whether or not her introduction was an attack-minded substitution. ‘It's funny, because I had a conversation with the technical staff,' said the head coach following the win over the Italian side. 'I made the final decision, and someone in my technical staff said: "But we need to score, and you are bringing on a defensive player"! ‘We laughed after the game because I said: "Right now she's scoring a lot of goals, so I don't know if she's more defensive or an attacking player”! It worked, so it's good. I was confident Ellie would create a lot in the second half.’ At the moment, Carpenter is covering enough ground down the right flank to be both. She scored against Charlton, but also won the most tackles (three) and made the most ball recoveries (12) of any player on the team. ‘I’m proud of the group,’ the Blues No2 said after the win at The Valley. ‘Our number one goal in this game was to get the three points and keep a clean sheet. We wanted to score, and it’s great to come and see so many different goal scorers. There are a lot of positives from Sunday that we’ll take into the next game.’ A deeper look into Carpenter’s stats shows her impact on the team this season. In the Women's Super League, the Australian has played the most minutes of any outfield Chelsea player (714), is ranked highest for big chances created (seven), has the most touches in the opposition box (56), possession won (46 times) and possession won in the final third (10). She is also second in the team for expected assists (2.79) and chances created (19). Her numbers are not only high within the Chelsea side, but also league-wide. Only Khadija Shaw and Lauren Hemp of Manchester City plus Victoria Pelova of Tottenham Hotspur have had more touches in the opposition box than Carpenter’s 56. Only Hemp has created more chances than Carpenter in the WSL. ‘It feels really good,’ the wing-back continued after the win over Charlton. 'I'm just trying to do my best on the ball in every game, so I'm really proud of that.’
news.body_zh: 周末我们以 6-0 战胜查尔顿竞技队的比赛中，埃莉·卡彭特攻入了本赛季的第五个进球，她的进球数已经超过了上赛季的三个进球总数。而且现在才十一月。这位边后卫现在正在为蓝军效力第二个赛季，她在球队本赛季的成功中发挥了关键作用，到目前为止，我们在我们的 13 场比赛中只首发了一场。上周，卡彭特在女足欧冠对阵罗马的比赛中半场替补，比分锁定为0-0，在比赛重新开始后六分钟内就取得进球。赛后，索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释说，关于她的上场是否属于进攻型换人存在一些争议。 “这很有趣，因为我和技术人员进行了交谈，”主教练在战胜意大利队后说道。 “我做出了最后的决定，我的技术人员中有人说：‘但是我们需要得分，而你却派上了一名防守球员’！” “赛后我们都笑了，因为我说：“现在她进了很多球，所以我不知道她是更注重防守还是更注重进攻”！它起作用了，所以很好。我相信埃莉会在下半场创造很多机会。”目前，卡彭特在右翼覆盖了足够的空间，可以兼任这两个角色。她在对阵查尔顿的比赛中进球，同时也是全队球员中赢得最多拦截（3次）和接球最多（12次）的球员。 “我为这支球队感到自豪，”蓝军二号人物在山谷获胜后说道。 “这场比赛我们的首要目标是全取三分并保持不失球。我们想要进球，很高兴能看到这么多不同的进球者。周日的很多积极因素我们都会带入下一场比赛。”深入研究卡彭特的统计数据可以看出她本赛季对球队的影响。在女足超级联赛中，澳大利亚人是切尔西外场球员中出场时间最多的球员（714分钟），创造的绝佳机会排名最高（7次），在对方禁区触球次数最多（56次），赢得控球次数（46次）和在最后三区赢得控球次数（10次）。她的预期助攻数（2.79）和创造机会数（19）也位居队内第二。她的数据不仅在切尔西队内很高，而且在整个联盟中也很高。只有曼城的卡迪嘉·肖和劳伦·亨普以及托特纳姆热刺队的维多利亚·佩洛娃在对方禁区内的触球数比卡彭特的 56 次多。在 WSL 中，只有亨普创造的机会比卡彭特多。 “感觉真的很好，”这位边后卫在战胜查尔顿后继续说道。 “我只是在每场比赛中尽力做到最好，所以我对此感到非常自豪。”

news.title: Sonia Bompastor on why every tiny detail matters for Chelsea this season
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 谈为何本赛季每个微小细节对切尔西都很重要
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor outlined her high standards at both ends of the pitch after her side recorded a 6-0 victory over Charlton Athletic at The Valley on Sunday afternoon. The Blues fired 36 shots on goal during the 90 minutes, 11 of which were on target, while we also reduced the home side to just six shots in total, with only one of theirs finding the target. We also hit the woodwork twice and held 71 per cent of the possession in a display of total dominance on Sunday afternoon. The six-goal victory returned Chelsea to the top of the Women's Super League standings, level on points with Manchester City. It is our record at both ends of the pitch which separates us from our rivals. The Blues have scored 27 times and conceded just four goals in the WSL, recording a goal difference of +23, which works out as 11 more than our rivals, who are currently on +12. For that very reason, Bompastor stressed the importance of maintaining our attacking ruthlessness throughout the campaign. 'This league is so competitive,' she said. 'Every detail is important. Right now, we are top of the table only on goal difference. We need to make sure we go into every game with the desire to score as many goals as we can as well as the desire not to concede. That's part of our mindset and mentality.' The Chelsea head coach was also delighted with the approach shown by her players from the opening whistle. 'We wanted to start the game strong in terms of the performance, the intensity, being aggressive, but also with the ball,' she explained. 'We wanted to score early in the game and make sure we were going into half-time with the advantage. I think that's what the players have done on the pitch and I'm really pleased about that.' The Blues now have five days to prepare for Saturday's WSL clash against Everton at Stamford Bridge, before a pivotal week with an away Women's Champions League fixture against Hacken on Tuesday 10 November and a blockbuster clash with Man City back at the Bridge on Saturday 14 November.
news.body_zh: 周日下午，索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 的球队在山谷球场 (The Valley) 6-0 战胜查尔顿竞技队 (Charlton Athletic)，她在攻防两端展现出高标准。蓝军在 90 分钟内射门 36 次，其中 11 次射正，而我们也将主队的射门总数减少到只有 6 次，只有 1 次射正。周日下午，我们还两次击中门框，占据了 71% 的控球率，展现了绝对的统治力。六粒进球的胜利让切尔西重回女足超级联赛积分榜榜首，与曼城持平。正是我们在攻防两端的战绩将我们与对手区分开来。蓝军在WSL中进了27个球，只丢了4个球，净胜球为+23，比我们的对手多了11个，而我们的对手目前的净胜球为+12。正是出于这个原因，邦帕斯托尔强调了在整个竞选过程中保持进攻残酷性的重要性。 “这个联盟的竞争非常激烈，”她说。 “每个细节都很重要。目前，我们仅在净胜球方面位居榜首。我们需要确保我们带着尽可能多的进球欲望和不失球的欲望去参加每场比赛。这是我们心态和心态的一部分。切尔西主教练也对她的球员在开场哨声中表现出的表现感到高兴。 “我们希望在比赛开始时表现出色、强度大、侵略性强，而且控球能力也很强，”她解释道。 “我们希望在比赛早期就进球，并确保我们带着优势进入半场。我认为这就是球员们在球场上所做的，我对此感到非常高兴。”蓝军现在有五天的时间准备周六在斯坦福桥对阵埃弗顿的女足超级联赛，接下来是关键的一周，即11月10日周二客场对阵哈肯的女足冠军联赛，以及11月14日周六在斯坦福桥与曼城的重磅对决。

news.title: Chelsea Diary: Blues prepare for Sunderland trip and Everton showdown
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：蓝军备战桑德兰之旅和埃弗顿对决
news.body_en: It's another busy week at Chelsea, with Premier League and Women's Super League action to look forward to, a London derby for our young Blues and plenty of exclusive content coming your way on the Chelsea Official App and website. We continue our reflections on the weekend, including the Blues' 2-0 win over Manchester United in the Premier League and CFCW's impressive 6-0 triumph at Charlton Athletic in the Women's Super League. There is reaction, highlights and analysis on the Chelsea Official App and website as we reflect on the latest victories from our sides. Attention will then turn to another important weekend of domestic football, with the Blues preparing for trips to Sunderland and Tottenham Hotspur, while our women's team get ready to welcome Everton to Stamford Bridge. We will hear from Giulia Dragoni on Tuesday, with the Italian midfielder discussing her experiences of adapting to life in England following a summer switch from Roma. Dragoni, who netted against Charlton, will reflect on settling into new surroundings, getting to know her team-mates and adjusting to the demands of English football. There will also be the latest news from Cobham as our men's team continue their preparations for Sunday's Premier League trip to Sunderland. The decisive match of Cobham Next Gen’s opening UEFA Youth League tie arrives on Wednesday afternoon, when the Blues host Flora Tallinn at Cobham in a 1pm kick-off. Following a 2-2 draw away in Estonia last week, there is still all to play for in the second leg, and CFC+ subscribers can watch it live in our Cobham Next Gen vs Flora Tallinn Match Centre. We will also continue building towards the weekend's fixtures on Wednesday, with the latest from Cobham as Alonso and his players prepare for the challenge awaiting them at the Stadium of Light. CFCW will also be putting in the work on the training pitches ahead of Saturday's Women's Super League meeting with Everton. With Bompastor's side returning to Stamford Bridge, we will be looking ahead to the contest with the Toffees and bringing supporters the latest news from the women's camp. Our focus turns towards the weekend's Premier League action as Chelsea prepare to face Sunderland away from home. The Blues will be looking to produce another strong performance on the road, and we will have all the latest news and features ahead of Sunday's encounter. It is press conference day at Cobham, with both Xabi Alonso and Sonia Bompastor facing the media ahead of their respective weekend fixtures. Alonso will be answering questions ahead of our trip to the Stadium of Light, and will be providing the latest team news and sharing his thoughts on the challenge posed by the Black Cats. Bompastor will also be speaking to the media as our Women's team prepare to host Everton to Stamford Bridge on Saturday. You can watch both of those pre-match press conferences live on the Chelsea Official App and website, or catch up on demand later in the day. There is a double helping of Chelsea action on Saturday, beginning at Cobham, where our Under-18s welcome Charlton Athletic in the Under-18 Premier League Cup. The match kicks off at 11am, with the young Blues looking to make home advantage count as they continue their cup campaign. CFC+ subscribers can watch the game live in our Chelsea Under-18s vs Charlton Athletic Match Centre. Attention then turns to Stamford Bridge, where Chelsea host Everton in the Women's Super League. Kick-off is at 12.45pm and the match will be broadcast live on Sky Sports in the UK. Tickets are available here, while those unable to attend can follow all the build-up, confirmed team news, minute-by-minute updates and reaction in our Chelsea Women vs Everton Match Centre. We will also have highlights and reaction from Bompastor and her players following the final whistle. We round off the week with two away fixtures, as Chelsea's men's team travel to Sunderland and Cobham Next Gen face Tottenham Hotspur in a London derby. Alonso's Blues head to the Stadium of Light for a 2pm kick-off, looking to build on last weekend's 2-0 victory over Manchester United and secure another important Premier League win. The match will be broadcast live on Sky Sports in the UK, while supporters can follow all the build-up, confirmed team news, minute-by-minute updates and live commentary in our Sunderland vs Chelsea Match Centre. We will also bring you highlights and reaction from Alonso and his players after the final whistle. There is a London derby for Cobham Next Gen, who travel to face Tottenham in the Premier League 2. The young Blues will be aiming to pick up another positive result against their capital rivals, with the game shown live for CFC+ subscribers in our Tottenham Hotspur vs Cobham Next Gen Match Centre.
